lcc_original: 凡有血肉的衆生，每樣兩個，你要帶進樓船，好和你一同保全性命：有公有母。
notes: LCC repositions 公/母 to end (有公有母) vs. UNV mid-sentence (一公一母); SNs 02145 and 05347 moved to match LCC word order accordingly.

LCC uses explicit 有 in 有公有母 where UNV kept יִהְיוּ (01961) implicit {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>}; per rule 3, braces dropped and 01961+8799 attached to the first 有 as explicit copula. The second 有 is a Chinese rhetorical parallel with no separate Hebrew correspondent.
LCC 和 ('with') is the explicit rendering of אֵת (0854) where UNV used 在...那裡 with the SN trailing; 0854 attached directly to 和.
Second and third occurrences of min-kol (04480+03605) remain implicit in LCC as in UNV — no explicit Chinese word bridges them.
LCC 衆生 ('all living beings') maps directly to UNV 活物 (02416); LCC 樓船 maps to UNV 方舟 (08392) — both are clearly equivalent terms.
